summary: Expanded the universe around policy- and load-growth-driven grid bottlenecks by prioritizing less obvious US-listed suppliers and service firms rather than the crowded mega-cap electrification leaders. Reference anchors for this node remain GE Vernova, Eaton, Hubbell, Quanta Services, and large utilities, but this pass highlights companies one or two steps away from the obvious story: custom medium-voltage switchgear, conduit/cable-management, electrical T&D field execution, and grid-planning/utility program software. These candidates are research leads, not recommendations; survival in later Serenity layers depends on verifying backlog quality, customer concentration, book-to-bill, margin durability, labor availability, and exposure to regulated utility/data-center/critical-infrastructure capex.
